tasks.title: Conversation #119
tasks.transcript:
Man: Are you going to the book club meeting tonight?
Woman: Yes, I am. I just finished reading the book we're discussing.
Man: Great. What did you think of it?
Woman: I loved it. The characters were so well developed. I felt I knew them.
Man: I agree. I'm looking forward to hearing everyone's thoughts.

questions.stem: What event are the speakers discussing?

options.D: A book made into a film

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：说话者在讨论什么活动？ 定位原文：Man: Are you going to the book club meeting tonight? 选项分析： A. A bookstore's opening 一家书店的开业。对话中未提及书店开业，所以A选项错误。 B. A book club meeting 读书俱乐部聚会。男士明确提到“book club meeting”，所以B选项正确。 C. An author's presentation 一位作者的演讲/发布会。对话中未提及作者本人到场，所以C选项错误。 D. A book made into a film 被改编成电影的书。对话中未提及电影改编，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What did the woman think about the book?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：女士对这本书有什么看法？ 定位原文：Woman: I loved it. The characters were so well developed. I felt I knew them. 选项分析： A. It was expensive but good. 它很贵但很好。对话中未提及书的价格，所以A选项错误。 B. It had well-developed characters. 它有塑造得很好的角色。女士明确说角色塑造得很好（well developed），所以B选项正确。 C. It was too short. 它太短了。对话中未提及书的长度，所以C选项错误。 D. It had a confusing plot. 它的情节令人困惑。女士表示喜欢这本书，没有说情节混乱，所以D选项错误。
